$meta.description: Motion tokens. Apple UI motion is spring based. Duration and bounce are the perceptual model from WWDC23 Animate with springs.

sources.swiftui: SwiftUI Animation.default = spring(response 0.55, dampingFraction 1.0); smooth, snappy, bouncy presets
sources.wwdc23: Spring model: duration and bounce map to stiffness and damping
sources.estimate: transition specific values tuned to match iOS 27 recordings

springModel.$usage: Convert duration d (seconds) and bounce b to physics with mass 1: stiffness = (2*pi/d)^2; damping = 4*pi*(1-b)/d when b >= 0, else 4*pi/(d*(1+b)). Flutter SpringDescription(mass:1, stiffness, damping). Framer Motion / motion: { type: 'spring', visualDuration: d, bounce: b }.

smooth.usage: Layout changes, fades with movement, size changes

snappy.usage: Selection changes, toggles, segmented indicator, small UI responses

bouncy.usage: Playful confirmations, glass morph, drop into place. Use rarely.

interactive.usage: Finger tracking, press down, drag follow. Must be near instant.

sheet.usage: Sheet present and dismiss, detent changes

popover.usage: Menus, popovers, context menus scale in from source

glassMorph.usage: Liquid Glass shapes merging, splitting, tab bar minimize

cssFallbackEasing.$usage: Only when a JS spring is impossible (pure CSS transitions). build-tokens.mjs samples each spring in springs{} and emits --cf-ease-<name> as a CSS linear() curve plus --cf-dur-<name> settle duration. Never use ease, ease-in-out or linear keywords for movement.

sheetPresent.scrim: fade 0 to scrim alpha in same spring
sheetPresent.backgroundScale: underlying content stays at 1.0 on iOS 26+ (no card stack shrink) except fullscreen cover

menuOpen.from: scale 0.6 from the source anchor opacity 0

tabSwitch.indicator: glass capsule slides with spring snappy

press.$usage: Every tappable thing has a press state. Values per category.

listRow.background: fillIOS.quaternary on iOS (gray5 light / gray4 dark)

hover.$usage: Pointer devices only (@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)). Never on touch.
hover.macOSListRow: no hover background except in sidebars and menus
hover.link: no underline on hover in app UI
hover.cursor: default arrow on buttons in macOS style; pointer cursor only for web links

scroll.scrollEdgeEffect: content under bars fades and softly blurs over the top 40 to 60pt instead of a hard bar background

reducedMotion.$usage: When prefers-reduced-motion or the OS setting is on: replace slides, scales and bounces with 200ms crossfades. Keep spring bounce 0. Disable parallax and glass wobble. Never remove state feedback.

symbolEffects.bounce: scale 1 to 1.2 to 1 with snappy spring
symbolEffects.replace: old symbol scales to 0.6 and fades while new scales from 0.6, 250ms
